UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private JDCOEM student profile storing name, branch, semester, and confirmed phone number.

branch.description: Academic branch or department (e.g., CSE, IT, ETC, ME).

semester.description: Current semester number (e.g., Sem 1 to Sem 8).

phoneNumber.description: Phone number entered by the student to confirm item lending and borrowing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Campus-visible student profile containing non-sensitive details (name, branch, semester) without phone numbers or emails.

visibility.description: Campus visibility scope used for scoped public profile queries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the public profile was last updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

CampusItem.title: CampusItem
CampusItem.description: An item shared by a student for other signed-in students across devices.

description.description: Short note or pickup details for the shared item.

photoUrl.description: Compressed JPEG data URL photo of the shared item.

category.description: Category label shown on the item card.

listingType.description: Whether the item is listed for temporary lending/borrowing or permanent selling.

price.description: Selling price in INR (0 for lending/borrowing items, > 0 for permanent sale items).

soldToId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who purchased a permanent sale item, or null.

soldToName.description: Display name of the student who purchased a permanent sale item, or null.

paymentId.description: Verified payment record ID associated with the purchase, or null.

visibility.description: Campus visibility scope used for scoped list queries.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who added the item.

authorName.description: Display name of the student who added the item.

authorPhone.description: Confirmed pickup phone number of the student sharing the item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated.

CampusRequest.title: CampusRequest
CampusRequest.description: Private lending/borrowing request sent directly to the student who listed the item, visible only to the involved borrower, lender, and admins.

description.description: Optional pickup note or message sent privately from borrower to lender.

itemPhotoUrl.description: Optional linked lending item photo URL, or null.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the borrow request.

visibility.description: Strictly private visibility restricting access to borrower, lender, and admins.

requesterId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the borrowing student.

requesterName.description: Display name of the borrowing student.

requesterPhone.description: Private phone number of the borrowing student visible only to borrower, lender, and admin.

borrowerRatingAverage.description: Borrower profile average star rating (0 to 5) at the time of request.

borrowerRatingCount.description: Number of exchange ratings on the borrower profile at the time of request.

acceptedById.description: Firebase Auth UID of the item lister (lender) who receives and responds to the request.

acceptedByName.description: Display name of the item lister (lender).

acceptedByPhone.description: Private phone number of the item lister (lender).

borrowerFulfilled.description: True once the borrower confirms their lending/return completion action.

borrowerFulfilledAt.description: Server timestamp when the borrower confirmed completion, or null.

lenderFulfilled.description: True once the lender confirms their lending/return completion action.

lenderFulfilledAt.description: Server timestamp when the lender confirmed completion, or null.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp when both confirmations fulfilled the borrow request, or null.

cancelledAt.description: Server timestamp when either party cancelled the pending request, or null.

cancelledById.description: UID of the party who cancelled the request, or null.

cancelledByRole.description: Role of the party who cancelled the request, or null.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was last updated.

BorrowRequestLock.title: BorrowRequestLock
BorrowRequestLock.description: Atomic duplicate-prevention lock keyed by itemId_borrowerId while a borrow request is Pending.

borrowerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the borrower.

lenderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the lender.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lock was created.

ExchangeRating.title: ExchangeRating
ExchangeRating.description: Public 1-5 star rating and optional comment submitted after a completed borrow or permanent purchase transaction.

requestId.description: ID of the completed campusRequest or purchaseRequest document.

exchangeSummary.description: Short non-private summary of the completed exchange (item title or request description).

raterId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who wrote the rating.

raterName.description: Display name of the rating author (no phone numbers).

raterRole.description: Role of the rating author in the fulfilled exchange.

rateeId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student being rated.

rateeName.description: Display name of the student being rated.

comment.description: Optional short written comment about the completed exchange.

isEdited.description: True if the author edited the rating within the 24-hour edit window.

visibility.description: Campus visibility scope used for scoped public rating queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the rating was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the rating was last updated.

CampusPayment.title: CampusPayment
CampusPayment.description: Backend-verified payment record for purchasing a permanent sale item on CampusConnect.

transactionRef.description: Human-readable transaction reference generated by the backend.

itemId.description: ID of the campusItem being purchased.

itemTitle.description: Title of the item being purchased.

listingType.description: Must be sell for payable permanent item transactions.

amount.description: Authoritative item selling price in INR.

paymentMethod.description: Built-in CampusConnect payment method selected by the buyer.

payerAccountRef.description: Masked payer UPI ID or campus reference label.

verifiedByBackend.description: True only after the Express backend verifies the payment.

failureReason.description: Error reason if payment status is Failed, or null.

buyerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the buyer.

sellerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the seller.

visibility.description: Restricted visibility scope limiting reads strictly to buyer and seller.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment was initiated.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment was last updated.

PurchaseRequest.title: PurchaseRequest
PurchaseRequest.description: Private permanent-item purchase request between one borrower and one lender with two-party payment confirmation and timestamped lifecycle audit trail.

itemTitle.description: Product name of the permanent-sale item.

itemPhotoUrl.description: Optional thumbnail URL of the permanent-sale item, or null.

finalAmount.description: Agreed final amount paid in INR (defaults to listedPrice and can reflect negotiation before confirmation).

borrowerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the borrower sending the purchase request.

borrowerPhone.description: Private phone number of the borrower visible only to the involved borrower and lender.

borrowerRatingAverage.description: Borrower profile average star rating (0 to 5) at the time of request.

borrowerRatingCount.description: Number of exchange ratings on the borrower profile at the time of request.

lenderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the permanent-item lender/seller.

lenderPhone.description: Private phone number of the lender visible only to the involved borrower and lender.

status.description: Purchase request status; transitions to Completed only after both parties confirm.

borrowerConfirmed.description: True once the borrower confirms Payment made.

borrowerConfirmedAt.description: Server timestamp when the borrower confirmed Payment made, or null.

lenderConfirmed.description: True once the lender confirms Payment received.

lenderConfirmedAt.description: Server timestamp when the lender confirmed Payment received, or null.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp when both confirmations completed the purchase, or null.

cancelledAt.description: Server timestamp when either party cancelled the pending request, or null.

cancelledById.description: UID of the party who cancelled the request, or null.

cancelledByRole.description: Role of the party who cancelled the request, or null.

visibility.description: Strictly private visibility restricting access to borrower and lender only.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the purchase request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the purchase request was last updated.

PurchaseRequestLock.title: PurchaseRequestLock
PurchaseRequestLock.description: Atomic duplicate-prevention lock keyed by itemId_borrowerId while a purchase request is Pending.

borrowerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the borrower.

lenderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the lender.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lock was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Private student profile storing name, branch, semester, and confirmed phone numbers.

/publicProfiles/{userId}.description: Campus-visible student profile storing non-private name, branch, and semester without phone numbers or emails.

/campusItems/{itemId}.description: Shared lending and permanent-sale items visible to all signed-in JDCOEM users across devices.

/campusRequests/{requestId}.description: Private lending/borrowing requests directed to the item lister and visible only to borrower, lender, and admins.

/borrowRequestLocks/{lockId}.description: Atomic duplicate-prevention lock documents keyed by itemId_borrowerId for active pending borrow requests.

/exchangeRatings/{ratingId}.description: Public exchange ratings visible to all signed-in JDCOEM users without private contact details.

/payments/{paymentId}.description: Legacy payment records visible only to the associated buyer and seller.

/purchaseRequests/{requestId}.description: Private permanent-item purchase requests visible only to the involved borrower, lender, and admins.

/purchaseRequestLocks/{lockId}.description: Atomic duplicate-prevention lock documents keyed by itemId_borrowerId for active pending purchase requests.
